verdict.rationale: Bento is an observability platform that ingests customer traces, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no training opt-out, data-use policy, or privacy control. The only related mention is that Bento 'trains a signal on your own traces', which describes using customer data for detectors rather than a way to prevent model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
